source: Combined release cross-review of historical Google Search Console performance rows and existing noindex/meta-refresh retirement fallbacks.
policy: A retired address receives one clean permanent server redirect only when the existing canonical, visible fallback link, and topic intent all agree on a current indexable destination. The repository-managed clean URL normalizer covers the matching .html request after canonical-host routing. The local file remains a compact noindex fallback without hreflang or structured-data signals.
